title: QuickPath hatch-tiles: compact inline help with contextual doc links
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact, low-friction inline help surface ("hatch-tiles") that appears contextually during first-run flows and important surface interactions. The hatch-tiles combine a short two-line tip, a lightweight illustrative micro-icon, and one contextual doc link that opens the console side panel. Purpose: reduce cognitive load for new users, increase self-serve activation, and reduce knowledge-gap support tickets.
background: Current inline help is a mix of long tooltips and modal walkthroughs which are too heavy for rapid onboarding. Support has flagged a spike in 'how to set up model pinning' and 'how to configure autoscale' questions after release 2025.12. This ticket scopes a reusable tile pattern that can be used across: model catalog, route creation, dedicated capacity setup, and rollout pages.
goals: Reduce first-run help dismissals (UI dismiss rate) by 15%
Increase doc-sidepanel opens from inline help by 25%
Ship a single Figma component set and 6 annotated screenshots for release assets
acceptance_criteria: Design spec with variant A/B copy and 2 visual density sizes delivered in Figma
Accessibility checks: contrast >= 4.5:1 for text, keyboard focus states documented, screen-reader label examples included
Annotated mocks with three placement contexts: toolbar, table-row action, and empty-state panel
Handoff package: SVG icons, tokenized spacing, CSS/vars suggestions, image assets, and developer notes
Design review sign-off from PM (Asha Patel) and Eng lead (Noah Blake)
deliverables: 6 annotated PNG screenshots for release notes and marketing
Accessibility checklist and copy variants spreadsheet
Handoff zip: icons + tokens + CSS snippets
tasks: Wireframes for dense and airy variants
Create side-panel doc templates and deep-link anchors
Produce release screenshots with staged sample data
design_notes: Primary pattern should be <48px tall for compact and 72px for roomy
Use neutral token palette with 1 accent color variant tied to product area (models/console/infra)
Tiles should support optional action buttons (e.g., 'Open doc', 'Try sample') but default to a single doc link
Avoid modal interruptions during critical flows; tiles must be dismissible and sticky for the session
When appearing in tables (e.g., routes list), tile should align left inside the row and not shift layout
a11y_checks: Provide aria-describedby linking tile to side-panel content
Focus trap must not occur; tab order should progress naturally
Keyboard dismiss via Esc + a visible close control
Screen-reader copy must include short context + CTA label
implementation_dependencies: PM-2216: final copy approval and analytics events contract
metrics_and_experiment_plan: Experiment: roll out compact vs roomy tiles to 50/50 new signups for 3 weeks
Primary metric: doc-sidepanel open rate from tile clicks
Secondary metrics: task completion on first-run flows, support ticket mentions
Instrumentation: add event 'hatch_tile_shown' and 'hatch_tile_cta_click' with context tags
